intro: Every item that holds stock: standalone products and variants. Change one product's counts, then save it.
threshold_label: Low stock is this many or fewer
threshold_helper_text: One number for the whole store, from 0 to 1,000,000. 0 means nothing counts as low.
threshold_failed: Couldn't save the low-stock number. Try again.
search_label: Search by product name or SKU
blocked: You have unsaved changes to {{active}}. Save or cancel them before editing {{blocked}}.
save_failed: Couldn't save all of the stock for {{name}}. What wasn't saved is still marked as changed. Try again.
start_tracking_product: Enter how many you have, then save. 0 means out of stock.
start_tracking_variants: Enter how many of each variant you have, then save. A variant left blank stays untracked.
error: Couldn't load the stock. Reload the page to try again.
access_denied: You don't have access to this store's products.
